title: Resilience sprint checkpoint — Nov 08 2026
summary: Weekly checkpoint for the resilience sprint. Covers two minor incidents, SLO health snapshot, on-call handoff notes and immediate action items for the next two weeks.
body:
Purpose:
Quick sync-style notes for the SRE team covering incidents, SLO status, recent mitigations, and handoff items. This is intended as a working doc — rough edits welcome.

Attendees / context:
- Maya Chen (lead on-call) — notes
- Ethan Rivera — infra follow-ups
- Priya Kapoor — service ownership
- Liam O'Connor — deployment & rollout ops
- Zara Mahmood — on-call shadow / observability

1) Incident roundup (past 7 days)
- Incident INC-4132 (2026-11-06 03:20 UTC) — short-term memory leak in redis-proxy service.
  - Symptoms: increased tail latency for chat completions when KV-cache miss rates spiked after a cache-eviction bug. JVM process RSS climbed steadily.
  - Impact: ~8% of hosted-api requests saw >500ms added p99 latency for ~42 minutes; no data loss, retries handled by client fallbacks.
  - Mitigation: manual restart of affected proxy pool + forced cache warming; applied temporary config to reduce eviction aggressiveness.
  - Root-cause hypothesis: cache eviction policy regression after rollout of config pruning (PR #4721).
  - Follow-ups: revert PR #4721 for next canary window; add memory accounting metrics to redis-proxy (see JIRA-ENG-7289); add alert for sustained RSS growth >5% over 10m.

- Incident (2026-11-04 11:12 UTC) — telemetry ingestion backlog on metrics-collector.
  - Symptoms: prometheus remote_write spikes queued due to downstream write throttling; alerting delayed 9–12 minutes.
  - Impact: monitoring alert delivery latency increased; no customer-facing outage.
  - Mitigation: scaled up collector pool by 2 nodes; throttling thresholds relaxed temporarily.
  - Follow-ups: add backpressure signals to pipeline, and a dashboard to surface write-queue length with 1m granularity.

2) SLO snapshot (rolling 30d ending 2026-11-08)
- Hosted API request latency SLO (p95 < 120ms): 95.9% — below target by 0.9%. Major contributor: redis-proxy blips + two deployment rollbacks.
- Chat completion success rate SLO (>=99.5%): 99.74% — within target.
- Embeddings throughput SLO (99th percentile tokens/sec): meeting target.
- Observations: single-component regressions (redis-proxy) are having outsized influence on p95 due to amplification under cache-miss spikes.

3) On-call handoff (details for next shift)
- Incoming on-call: Priya Kapoor (Nov 09 08:00 UTC start).
- Key context to pass: watch redis-proxy memory RSS and cache miss ratio; tickets in flight: JIRA-INC-4132 (investigation), JIRA-ENG-7289 (instrumentation).
- Handoff checklist:
  - Confirm PR #4721 is reverted or held for canary window.
  - Ensure temporary config reducing eviction aggressiveness remains until instrumentation is live.
  - Re-run cache warm job after low-traffic period (script: infra/scripts/cache_warm.py).
  - Observe alert: redis-proxy-rss-growth (threshold 5%/10m). If firing, escalate to infra-ops and run memory-dump workflow.

4) Runbook / playbook edits proposed
- Add section: "redis-proxy progressive restart" with a safe cadence for restarts to avoid client thundering (stagger 10s across pool).
- Add small diagnostic helper to runbook: "collect-redis-proxy-kv-snapshot" that captures approximate KV hit histogram.
- Update incident severity rubric to include "observability-degradation" when alerting latency >5m.

5) Ops & rollout notes
- Canary rollout for PR #4750 (kernel/alloc optimizations) pushed to 10% yesterday; telemetry shows no regressions. Keep canary at 10% for 48h before 50% expansion.
- Deployment window change: we will restrict large infra rollouts to 0200–0600 UTC on Tue/Thu to reduce overlap with customer peak windows.

6) Action items (owners & ETA)
- Ethan: add memory-accounting metrics to redis-proxy + instrumentation dashboard (ETA: 2026-11-15).
- Priya: hold revert for PR #4721 and coordinate canary policy (ETA: 2026-11-09 morning).
- Liam: add backpressure signals to metrics-collector pipeline and quick dashboard (ETA: 2026-11-16).
- Maya: draft short post-incident blameless note for INC-4132 (ETA: 2026-11-10).
- Zara: incorporate the new helper commands into runbook and test locally (ETA: 2026-11-12).

7) Open questions / discussion bits
- Do we want to treat redis-proxy as a critical tier for p95 SLO calculations or keep it aggregated? Pros/cons discussed — table for next retro.
- Long-term: consider whether prefix/KV cache should be moved to an isolated service to reduce blast radius. Need a short proposal.

8) Quick wins for next sprint
- Alert tuning: add change detection on RSS growth instead of absolute thresholds.
- Automate cache-warm after replay-restarts for the proxy pool.
- Add 1m granularity write-queue dashboard for metrics-collector.

Appendix (logs & references)
- Slack thread: #sre-ops: "redis-proxy memory blip" (link placeholder).
- PRs referenced: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4721, /pull/4750
- Jira: JIRA-INC-4132, JIRA-ENG-7289

Notes to self / rough ideas (informal)
- Could try a small synthetic that throttles cache warmed but not cold to measure amplification factor.
- Consider bumping memory-request for proxy pods modestly while we instrument — small cost increase but faster mitigation.

Next sync: quick 20m standup on Nov 10 09:30 UTC to review instrumentation progress and canary status.

---
Drafted by Maya Chen during on-call; will iterate after Priya triages first morning shift.
